endpoints.call: the WPJobBoard RSS (active listings) / FeedBlitz feed is a usable public feed
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. WordPress WPJobBoard site with a public RSS of active jobs; no developer API; robots.txt 5 rules; no terms page linked.

search.note: ProBlogger Job Board RSS (WPJobBoard, RSS 2.0) of active postings. query and location are the board's search parameters carried into the feed (checked 2026-09-25: ?query=writer and ?location=remote narrow it). The feed is one list, so page and limit are not sent (ignore next_page). category (job type and category) stays in raw. id is the posting link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.
